descriptions.2031: On death, a giant Tibbers with all your augments falls from the sky and damages nearby enemies.
descriptions.2032: A few seconds after death, a shark chomps all nearby enemies. You can move after death to aim the shark attack.
descriptions.2034: Sharks circle your Snowball, <status>slowing</status> and damaging nearby enemies. When your Snowball hits a Champion, they become trapped in a shark storm!
descriptions.2042: After entering <keyword>Brush</keyword>, deal <attention>20%</attention> more damage for <attention>2</attention> seconds. Remain in the <keyword>Brush</keyword> to refresh the effect.
descriptions.2043: Entering <keyword>Brush</keyword> regenerates <healing>a large amount of Health</healing>.
descriptions.2046:
QUEST: Gather Poro Snax and feed Poros.

REWARD: Gain the Poro Charge Summoner Spell, which launches waves of Poros at the enemy team. Additional waves unlock per Quest Level.

"Oho! Look how charming they are!" — Poro Herder
descriptions.2054: Your <font color='#F0C200'>Ability</font> targets 2 additional enemies in front of you.
descriptions.2055:
QUEST: Hit enemy Champions with Ability times.

REWARD: Fire additional missiles per Quest Level.
descriptions.2062: Casting your <font color='#F0C200'>Ability</font> sends a clone toward your mouse position and recasts it.
descriptions.2063: Gain the <spellName>When the Darkness Comes</spellName> Summoner Spell. Create a zone that transports everyone inside of it to another dimension.
descriptions.2064: When you use <font color='#F0C200'>Ability</font>, dash towards your cursor.
descriptions.2065: Whenever you cast <font color='#F0C200'>Ability</font>, <status>Fear</status> enemies around you.
descriptions.2072: Your <font color='#F0C200'>Ability</font> missile splits into two on hit, at max Range, or when <recast>Recast</recast>.
descriptions.2073: Damaging enemy champions with <font color='#F0C200'>Ability</font> <healing>heals</healing> you.
descriptions.2076: When <font color='#F0C200'>Ability</font> damages enemy champions, gain 1 - 3 <scaleArmor>Armor</scaleArmor> and <scaleMR>Magic Resistance</scaleMR>.
descriptions.2077: <status>Immobilizing</status> or <status>Grounding</status> enemy champions with <font color='#F0C200'>Ability</font> deals extra <magicDamage>damage</magicDamage> and <healing>heals you</healing>.
descriptions.2078: If a target <status>Knocked Back</status> by <font color='#F0C200'>Ability</font> hits another champion, they are <status>Knocked Up</status> and dealt <magicDamage>damage</magicDamage>. When colliding with terrain, the <status>Knock Up</status> duration is extended and they are dealt <magicDamage>bonus damage</magicDamage>.
descriptions.2080: Recasting <spellName>Snowball</spellName> deals increased damage, <status>Knocks Up</status> the target, and <status>Knocks Back</status> nearby enemies.
descriptions.2082: Whenever someone heals around you, you <healing>heal 15%</healing> of their own healing. Doubled from Enemy healing.
descriptions.2083: Bursting enemies drops <keyword>Teeth</keyword>. Picking up <keyword>Teeth</keyword> grants you permanent <scaleLethality>Lethality</scaleLethality> and <magicPen>Magic Penetration</magicPen>.
descriptions.2087: Casting a spell refunds another random spell's cost by 30% of the original spell's Cooldown.
descriptions.2088: Gain 100 Ability Haste on your Snowball. It deals additional magic damage when hitting an enemy. If you don't have one, gain a Snowball.
descriptions.2089: On takedown, enemy champions drop coins nearby, which you and your allies can collect. Each is worth <gold>15 gold</gold>.
descriptions.2091: While in combat, <keywordMajor>Autocast</keywordMajor> a circular axe that deals <physicalDamage>physical damage</physicalDamage>. Enemies on the outer edge take additional damage and <healing>heal</healing> you.
descriptions.2095: Nearby enemies have a chance to drop Stat Anvils on death.
descriptions.2096: Gain 150 Attack Range and 75% <attackSpeed>Attack Speed</attackSpeed> during your <font color='#F0C200'>Ability</font> duration.
descriptions.2097: Dashing with <font color='#F0C200'>Ability</font> spawns a Void Zone that <status>Slows</status> enemy champions and deals magic damage.
descriptions.2098: Periodically identify <keywordMajor>Vitals</keywordMajor> on enemy champions. Hitting them with Attacks or Abilities deals <trueDamage>max Health true damage</trueDamage>, <healing>restores Health</healing>, and grants <speed>Movement Speed</speed>. These effects can stack.
descriptions.2099: On takedown, enemy champions leave behind their Essence. Attacking the Essence grants <speed>movement speed</speed> and resets basic ability cooldowns.
descriptions.2100:
QUEST: Hit enemy champions with Ability times.

REWARD: Gain Ability Haste on Ability per Quest Level up to 2.
descriptions.2102:
Every second, apply a stacking Burn to nearby enemy champions, scaling with your max Health.

QUEST: Deal Burn damage to enemy Champions.

REWARD: Size and damage increase per Quest Level.
descriptions.2103:
QUEST: Snipe 15 enemy champions with abilities

REWARD: Send a meteor at Sniped enemy champions, dealing Magic damage in an area around them
descriptions.2104: <healing>Healing</healing> and <shield>Shielding</shield> allied champions builds up a Spirit Bomb. At max stacks, toss the bomb onto <scaleHealth>lowest Health ally</scaleHealth> to <healing>heal</healing> and <shield>shield</shield> them and nearby allies.
descriptions.2107: Damaging enemy champions with Attacks or Abilities grants stacks. At max stacks, you <attention>revive empowered</attention> upon death.
descriptions.2108:
QUEST: Heal allied champions for 3000 Health.

REWARD: Any healing you provide now also Heals Over Time after the initial heal.
descriptions.2109: Recast <font color='#F0C200'>Ability</font> to explode and return to your original position.
descriptions.2111: Attacks and Abilities empowered by <font color='#F0C200'>Ability</font> deal additional damage to the target and nearby enemies.
descriptions.2115: Occasionally send out squishy, slappy hands towards all nearby enemy champions, tethering them. Your next attack will pull in all tethered enemies.
descriptions.2116:
QUEST: Hit enemy champions with Ability times.

REWARD: Permanently increase Ability damage.
descriptions.2118: Your <scaleAbilityHaste>Ability Haste</scaleAbilityHaste> only applies to your <keyword>Ultimate</keyword>, but is 50% more effective. Gain <scaleAbilityHaste>100 Ability Haste</scaleAbilityHaste>.
descriptions.2119: Recall to enter your Cannon Launcher. It has significantly increased range, travel speed, and damage.
descriptions.2123: Using another Ability resets the cooldown of <font color='#F0C200'>Ability</font>.
descriptions.2125: Activating <font color='#F0C200'>Ability</font> grants you <speed>Movement Speed</speed> for its duration.
descriptions.2126: Basic Attacks %i:OnHit% <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit> during <font color='#F0C200'>Ability</font> reduce its cooldown.
descriptions.2127: Increase your Item and Augment damage by <attention>45%</attention>.
descriptions.2128: Burn and damage-over-time on champions generate <gold>gold</gold>.
descriptions.2129: Your <font color='#F0C200'>Ability</font> deals damage in an area around it.
descriptions.2131: Gain a <shield>Shield</shield> for every second you spend <attention>Channeling</attention>.
descriptions.2133: After healing or shielding your ally with <font color='#F0C200'>Ability</font>, your next basic attack gains <attention>attack range</attention>, <speed>attack speed</speed> and deals bonus <magicDamage>max Health magic damage</magicDamage>.
descriptions.2134: On Ultimate cast, spawn a <keywordMajor>Zone</keywordMajor> that grants <scaleAbilityHaste>Ability Haste</scaleAbilityHaste> and <speed>Movement Speed</speed>. While inside, it fires missiles that deal <magicDamage>20% of your damage</magicDamage>.
descriptions.2135: Attacks during <font color='#F0C200'>Ability</font> gouge your target with <keywordMajor>Nails</keywordMajor>. Nails accumulate damage, execute, and grant <MS>Movement Speed</MS> upon expiration.
descriptions.2136:
Striking enemy champions with Ability forges a bond of Friendship.

Ability gains temporarily increased damage based on your level of Friendship.
descriptions.2137: Allies encourage you when you walk past, granting you a <shield>Shield</shield> and <speed>Movement Speed</speed>.
descriptions.2138: Striking an enemy champion with <font color='#F0C200'>Ability</font> grants you <attention>7 - 12</attention> <scaleArmor>Armor</scaleArmor> or <scaleMR>Magic Resist</scaleMR> based on their damage type for 6 seconds. This effect can stack.
descriptions.2139: Taking damage from champions builds up a burst of needles that fly out of you, dealing damage and slowing nearby enemies.
descriptions.2140:
Your spell hits trigger Cleave against enemies. Increase Ravenous Hydra's Life Steal to 20%

Gain 500 Gold.
descriptions.2141:
Gain a Tiamat when completing a Hydra Item.

QUEST: Gain Ravenous Hydra, Profane Hydra and Titanic Hydra.

REWARD: Gain Ultra Hydra.
descriptions.2143:
Reduce Sundered Sky's per target cooldown to 5 seconds and heal you for 9% of missing health.

Gain 500 Gold.
descriptions.2144: Shields granted from <font color='#F0C200'>Ability</font> are stronger and scaling with target's missing Health.
descriptions.2148: <font color='#F0C200'>Ability</font> applies %i:OnHit% <OnHit>On-Hit</OnHit> effects an additional time.
descriptions.2157:
Gain %i:goldCoins% 250.

Death's Dance's Ignore Pain is increased to 40% of damage received, and heals for more instantly when scoring a takedown.
descriptions.12317: Transmute all of your augments into <keywordMajor>random Prismatic%i:Augment% Augments</keywordMajor>.
